features: LUXURY DESIGN, CRAFTED FOR COMFORT: 1000X THE COLLEXION headphones combine curated metal accents and soft vegan leather to create a refined and luxurious look, while generously sized earcups and a wider cushioned headband deliver comfortable wear, for long listening sessions.

STUDIO-GRADE SOUND QUALITY: A bespoke driver, co-tuned with renowned mastering engineers, delivers rich, wide-range sound with balanced lows, natural vocals and clear highs—revealing fine detail and precise separation for an expansive, studio-like soundstage.

SPATIAL AUDIO WITH 360 UPMIX: With 360 Reality Audio Upmix (360 Upmix), everyday stereo expands into immersive spatial sound. Choose Music, Cinema, or Game modes to enhance depth, direction, and impact, controlled using the Listening Mode button.

HD NOISE CANCELLING: Built utilizing the legendary 1000X Series noise cancelling, the HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN3 and Integrated Processor V3 use 12 microphones to optimize noise cancellation in real time for a quieter world and purer sound.
ADAPTIVE NC OPTIMIZER: Our Adaptive Noise Cancelling Optimizer adjusts in real time to external noise, air pressure, and your fit—so noise cancelling stays seamless and immersive wherever you listen.

ULTRA-CLEAR CALL QUALITY: A six-microphone AI beamforming system with Precise Voice Pickup Technology focuses on your voice, reduces background and wind noise, and helps make every word easier to hear—even in busy environments.

HIGH-RESOLUTION AUDIO: Enjoy High-Resolution Audio with and without wires. With High-Resolution Audio Wireless via LDAC, you can transmit approx. 3x more data than conventional Bluetooth audio for exceptional detail and clarity.

INTUITIVE CONTROLS: Distinct button shapes make Power, Noise Cancelling, and Listening Modes easy to identify by touch, so you can adjust settings quickly without looking. Customize shortcuts in the Sony | Sound Connect app to match how you listen.

SONY | SOUND CONNECT APP: With the Sony | Sound Connect app, you get quick access to music and partner services, plus easy sound tuning and shortcut customization. It can also track recent listening history and Safe Listening features to help monitor volume levels for healthier listening.
LONG BATTERY LIFE: Stay powered up with up to 24 hours of battery life. Need a quick top-up? Get up to 1.5 hours of use from just 5 minutes of charging—so you’re ready when you need it.
